shortDescription: China appointed Hu Changsheng as the Communist Party secretary of Tibet and he becomes the region's top political official while replacing Wang Junzheng, state news agency Xinhua reported on Tuesday.Hu previously served as party chief of the northwestern Chinese province of Gansu.
